text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
ORA ORA ORA ORAAAHH!! Move, move, move, 
move!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Golshi-sama's real show starts right now! 
—Unsinkable Battleship, weighing 
anchor-r-r!!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
(Gold Ship-san... That incredible 
toughness allowing you to run freely all 
over the track in such an unpredictable 
way... That is your weapon, isn't it?)

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
—However! If you control the power 
freely... just like this!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The winner is Gentildonna! Crushing even 
the Classic Double Crown Umamusume of her 
generation with overwhelming, breathtaking 
power--!!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Phew... phew...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu. Fufufu...!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Gwah!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I'm... done for... Water... bring me 
water...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Shall I pour it over your head?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: —I lost. I don't take charity.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Still though, to swing even Golshi-chan 
right around... You really are one heck of 
a grand dame.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I just couldn't resist... I had to catch 
it.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Hohoho. With your grip strength, you 
wouldn't even be able to grab my wrist, 
you know.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Want me to give your ankle a little snip?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Fair enough, the tuna is all yours. ...And 
so is the Bermuda Triangle.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
However! The giga-colossal squid is... 
something I won't give up.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna cook up some piping-hot rice for 
ya. Get some nori ready and wait!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"If that is to be your last supper, then I 
shall accompany you once more."

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
What an incredible battle……! Orfevre's 
great and all, but this is fiery too!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"I wanna see it again! The top two leading 
the generation! Clashes within the same 
generation really are the best!"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: I am... It is I who—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
She was a threat you couldn't help but be 
conscious of... without a doubt.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
So you learned, didn't you? That stubborn 
step forward...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
—From the sheer strength of that person 
who kept pushing me to the brink.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: I am! Gentildonna-san's... rival!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"I won't waver anymore. I won't shatter. I 
won't give up. If she's going that far 
ahead, then—"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I won't let them get away from behind. And 
then—I'll definitely strike back!!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Over there... and over here, too. How 
lively it is.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"I knew it was the right choice. Choosing 
this path..."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"—I can reach the 'strongest of all' in a 
straight line."

Gentildonna, who returned after the race 
was over, was...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Ohoho. Very much so.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"In racing, competitors with all sorts of 
strengths gather. Some have toughness, 
others have sheer willpower..."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Horizontally and vertically, we are never 
uniform. Constantly growing, constantly 
moving forward. And so—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Our polished powers will clash purely once 
again.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
If I can overcome every force, I will 
attain a power obvious to anyone—the 
absolute strongest.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
I want to know more... of everyone's power 
to reveal the beauty of a kaleidoscope as 
they run.

After this comes the summer training camp 
to grow stronger. She, along with the 
other Umamusume... will surely hone 
themselves further.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Now then. In order to reach the pinnacle 
of strength, which race should we tackle 
next?
choice_data_list: You should fight strong opponents again.
You should fight strong opponents again.

text_block_list.text:
Gentildonna has proven her strength across 
various races up to this point. If that's 
the case, then timing-wise, the most 
fitting race would be—

Among Japanese races, this GⅠ carries long 
history and high prestige. Countless 
legendary Umamusume have engaged in fierce 
battles here. You will surely have much to 
gain from it.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Those who seek prestige and authority... 
They make it all the more worthwhile to 
compete against.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Still, is there really anyone more 
accustomed to constant struggle... than I 
am?
choice_data_list:
Either way, that's something we can prove 
by winning.

Either way, winning is the only way to 
prove it.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"...Pardon me. Yes, I must prove it 
through results."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
It's decided. Let us proceed to the Tenno 
Sho (Autumn).

And so, the next target race was decided: 
the Tenno Sho (Autumn).
